product_launches.description: Rhoda AI emerged from stealth and unveiled its FutureVision robotic intelligence technology platform after 18 months of development.

overview_description.description: Rhoda is builds a robot foundation model designed to bring general intelligence into the physical world. By combining internet-scale video pretraining with closed-loop video predictive control, Rhoda aims to enable robots that can adapt, generalize, and operate autonomously across real-world environments. The company works with leading industrial partners across manufacturing and logistics.

about_short_description.short_description: Rhoda AI is a tech company that develops a class of robot foundation models designed to bring general intelligence into the physical world.

product.name: FutureVision
product.description: A general-purpose robotic foundation model that enables robots to perform and adapt to industrial tasks using web-scale video pre-training and robot-collected action data.

product.name: Robot Platform
product.description: A physical robotic platform designed to execute industrial tasks with high payload capacity, actuator-level braking, safety-rated vision, and long-term operating reliability.

product.name: Industrial Robotic Automation Deployment
product.description: Deployment of adaptive robotic systems for variable commercial and industrial workflows, including logistics, manufacturing, automotive, and ecommerce operations.
